meta.parties: Silva v. Salo Nona Et Al

rules.statement: Registration of an agreement to sell land is notice within the meaning of section 93 of the Trust Ordinance, provided the contract has been duly registered.
rules.supporting_quote: "The scheme is clearly meant to give notice to subsequent purchasers and others of previous dealings with the property" - vide Ennis J. in Rajapakse v. Fernando.
